dataset_name: Hybrid RAG Evaluation Q&A Dataset - New Corpus
description: Source-grounded evaluation questions for the six newly indexed documents. Chunk references use the current indexed_chunks.json export.

questions.question: Which authentication header must CloudScale Vector API requests include?
questions.expected_answer: A valid Bearer token in the Authorization HTTP header.

questions.question: What permission scopes can CloudScale API keys have?
questions.expected_answer: Read-only or read-write.

questions.question: Which endpoint inserts or updates vector embeddings with metadata?
questions.expected_answer: POST /v2/vectors/upsert.

questions.question: What is the maximum batch size for a CloudScale vector upsert request?
questions.expected_answer: 1,000 vectors per request.
acceptable_answers: An upsert request can contain up to 1,000 vectors.

questions.question: Which endpoint runs a nearest-neighbor vector similarity search?
questions.expected_answer: POST /v2/vectors/query.

questions.question: In the query API, what does the namespace identify?
questions.expected_answer: The target index partition used to isolate tenant datasets.

questions.question: What are the default and maximum values for the query top_k parameter?
questions.expected_answer: The default is 10 and the maximum is 100.
acceptable_answers: The query top_k default is 10, with a maximum of 100.

questions.question: Which operators can a CloudScale metadata filter support?
questions.expected_answer: $eq, $in, and $gte.

questions.question: Which client technologies are listed for CloudNote Pro across desktop, web, and mobile?
questions.expected_answer: Electron for macOS and Windows, React for web, and Swift/Kotlin for iOS and Android.

questions.question: What language is CloudNote Pro’s CRDT synchronization service written in, and what latency does it target?
questions.expected_answer: Rust; it merges concurrent edits with sub-50ms latency.
acceptable_answers: The service uses Rust and targets under 50 ms while merging concurrent edits.
The Rust CRDT synchronization service merges concurrent edits with a target latency under 50 ms.

questions.question: What database and access-control feature store CloudNote Pro metadata and permissions?
questions.expected_answer: A PostgreSQL cluster with row-level security.
acceptable_answers: CloudNote Pro stores metadata and permissions in a PostgreSQL cluster protected by row-level security.

questions.question: How are CloudNote Pro document blobs and media stored?
questions.expected_answer: In AES-256-encrypted object storage with automated regional replication.

questions.question: What causes the structural sync conflict described in the knowledge base?
questions.expected_answer: One user deletes a parent folder while another offline user adds new documents inside it.
acceptable_answers: A structural conflict occurs if one user deletes a parent folder while another offline user adds documents inside it.

questions.question: Where should a user go to resolve the sync conflict, and what should they compare?
questions.expected_answer: Open the Conflict Resolution Drawer and compare the Local Version and Cloud Version timestamps.
acceptable_answers: Open the Conflict Resolution Drawer, then compare the Local Version and Cloud Version timestamps.

questions.question: What two choices does CloudNote Pro offer for resolving orphaned notes after a folder conflict?
questions.expected_answer: Keep Both restores the folder structure with the offline notes; Merge into Active Workspace moves orphaned notes to the root directory.

questions.question: How many workspace members can the CloudNote Pro Starter plan have?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 3 members.
acceptable_answers: The Starter plan supports up to 3 members.

questions.question: What is the Team plan price and its REST API rate limit?
questions.expected_answer: $12 per user per month and 1,000 requests per minute.
acceptable_answers: The Team plan costs $12 per user per month and allows 1,000 REST API requests per minute.

questions.question: What protects CloudNote Pro client-server traffic in transit?
questions.expected_answer: TLS 1.3 with strict certificate pinning on mobile clients.

questions.question: What encryption is used for documents at rest, and which plan offers customer-managed keys?
questions.expected_answer: AES-256-GCM; customer-managed keys are available on Enterprise plans.

questions.question: Which compliance standards or agreements are listed for CloudNote Pro?
questions.expected_answer: Annual SOC 2 Type II audits, GDPR compliance, and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements upon request.

questions.question: Who published the sample business document and where is the publisher based?
questions.expected_answer: Pine & Birch, a technology consulting firm in Toronto.
acceptable_answers: Pine & Birch, a Toronto-based technology consulting firm, published the document.

questions.question: How does the sample business document describe repeated downloads?
questions.expected_answer: The content is deterministic and identical downloads are byte-for-byte identical.
acceptable_answers: Repeated downloads are deterministic: the same file is byte-for-byte identical.
Repeated downloads are deterministic: each download is byte-for-byte identical, supporting reliable fixtures and checksums.

questions.question: Does the sample DOCX contain macros, scripts, or tracking?
questions.expected_answer: No; it states that it has no macros, scripts, or tracking.
acceptable_answers: No—the DOCX contains no macros, scripts, or tracking.

questions.question: What should testers compare after parsing the sample DOCX?
questions.expected_answer: The extracted text, page count, and metadata against the download page values.

questions.question: What document structures does the sample business file include?
questions.expected_answer: Headings, paragraphs, bulleted and numbered lists, a data table, an embedded image, and page breaks.

questions.question: What are the customer, product, quantity, and total for DOCX order PB-100003?
questions.expected_answer: Silverline Freight; Data Migration; quantity 4; $9,600.00.

questions.question: According to the PDF, why should a document’s original structure be preserved?
questions.expected_answer: It maintains meaning and context and supports better chunking, retrieval, and accurate answers.
acceptable_answers: Preserving the original layout and hierarchy retains meaning and context and supports better chunking, retrieval, and accurate answers.

questions.question: What benefits does the PDF attribute to good chunking?
questions.expected_answer: Improved retrieval relevance, reduced noise, and better context understanding.
acceptable_answers: Good chunking improves retrieval relevance, reduces noise, and improves the model’s understanding of context.

questions.question: How does the PDF define semantic chunking, and what documents is it best for?
questions.expected_answer: It splits by meaning and semantic similarity and is best for complex documents.

questions.question: What four ingestion architecture outcomes are listed as key takeaways in the PDF?
questions.expected_answer: Handle multiple document types, preserve structure and metadata, generate high-quality embeddings, and keep the index updated.

questions.question: Which quality checks does the PDF say an ingestion pipeline should perform?
questions.expected_answer: Check for missing content, OCR errors, and chunk-size validation.

questions.question: Name common metadata fields shown in the PDF.
questions.expected_answer: Source, location, permissions, content type, custom tags, and timestamps.

questions.question: What steps does the presentation list for integrating analytics?
questions.expected_answer: Create an account and property, paste the tracking snippet, and optionally add custom analytics.

questions.question: Where does the presentation say to find the tracking snippet?
questions.expected_answer: Select Admin, choose the account and property, then select Tracking Info > Tracking Code.
acceptable_answers: Admin > Account > select the account > Properties > select the property > Tracking Info > Tracking Code.
Open Admin, select the account and its property, then go to Tracking Info > Tracking Code.

questions.question: How do you reach the Events Overview interface?
questions.expected_answer: Reporting > Behavior > Events > Overview.
acceptable_answers: In Reporting, choose Behavior > Events > Overview.

questions.question: How do you reach the Real-time Events interface?
questions.expected_answer: Reporting > Real-time > Events.
acceptable_answers: In Reporting, choose Real-time > Events.

questions.question: How do you reach the Audience Overview interface?
questions.expected_answer: Reporting > Audience > Overview.
acceptable_answers: In Reporting, choose Audience > Overview.

questions.question: Which API should service-worker hits use, according to the presentation?
questions.expected_answer: The Measurement Protocol API.

questions.question: Which package and initialization call are shown for offline Google Analytics?
questions.expected_answer: Install sw-offline-google-analytics and call goog.offlineGoogleAnalytics.initialize() in the service worker.

questions.question: Why did the customer’s invoice rise from $15 to $24 in support record 001?
questions.expected_answer: Two additional team members accepted invitations, adding two Team Plan seats at $4.50 each.

questions.question: Where can a customer manage active CloudNote Pro seats?
questions.expected_answer: Settings > Billing > Team Members.

questions.question: What did support do after the unrecognized Frankfurt login, and what did it ask the customer to do?
questions.expected_answer: Support revoked active session tokens and enforced a password reset; the customer should set a unique passphrase, enable TOTP, and check their primary email password.
acceptable_answers: Support revoked active sessions and enforced a password reset; the customer should use a unique passphrase, enable TOTP, and secure the primary email account.

questions.question: What caused the macOS PDF export crash in version 4.2.1, and what workaround was offered?
questions.expected_answer: A memory-allocation bug rendering high-resolution embedded tables caused it; support advised exporting through the web app.
acceptable_answers: A memory-allocation bug while rendering high-resolution embedded tables caused the crash; support advised exporting through the web app.
A memory-allocation bug while rendering high-resolution embedded tables caused the export crash; the workaround is to export through the web app.

questions.question: Why was the API backup script throttled despite sending about 300 requests, and what fixes were suggested?
questions.expected_answer: /v2/notes/export has a 60-requests-per-minute burst limit despite the 1,000 workspace-wide limit. Use exponential backoff or batch up to 25 note IDs per request.
acceptable_answers: /v2/notes/export has a 60-requests-per-minute burst limit due to payload size; use exponential backoff or batch up to 25 note IDs per request.

questions.question: A Team Plan workspace sends about 300 requests per minute but gets 429 errors on note exports. Why, and what should it change?
questions.expected_answer: The Team Plan limit is 1,000 per minute overall, but /v2/notes/export has a separate 60-per-minute burst limit. Use exponential backoff or batch up to 25 note IDs.
acceptable_answers: /v2/notes/export has a 60-requests-per-minute burst limit despite the workspace limit; use exponential backoff or batch up to 25 note IDs.

questions.question: How can CloudNote Pro merge text edits automatically yet still require a user to resolve the folder conflict?
questions.expected_answer: The Rust CRDT service merges concurrent text edits, but deleting a parent folder while another offline user adds files inside it creates a structural conflict. Resolve it in the Conflict Resolution Drawer.

questions.question: For the suspicious-login case, what actions were taken and which platform protections are documented?
questions.expected_answer: Support revoked active session tokens and enforced a password reset, then advised a unique passphrase and TOTP. Platform protections include TLS 1.3 with mobile certificate pinning and AES-256-GCM at rest.

questions.question: Based on the PDF, what should ingestion do with scanned pages and how should it check the resulting chunks?
questions.expected_answer: Use OCR to convert scanned images to text, preserve document structure and metadata, then check for missing content, OCR errors, and chunk-size problems.

questions.question: Describe an authenticated CloudScale vector query, including endpoint, required fields, and filter operators.
questions.expected_answer: Send POST /v2/vectors/query with a valid Bearer token in Authorization. Required fields include namespace and a vector matching index dimensionality; optional filters support $eq, $in, and $gte.

questions.question: Compare orders PB-100003 and PB-100005: who placed PB-100005, and how much larger was PB-100003?
questions.expected_answer: Harbourfront Textiles placed PB-100005. PB-100003 was $9,600 and PB-100005 was $297, so the difference is $9,303.

questions.question: How do I fix the issue?
questions.expected_answer: Are you seeing the offline sync-conflict banner, or is the macOS app freezing while exporting a large notebook to PDF?

questions.question: What rate limit applies to me?
questions.expected_answer: Which CloudNote plan are you on, and do you mean the workspace-wide API limit or the /v2/notes/export burst limit?

questions.question: How should I secure it?
questions.expected_answer: Are you responding to a suspicious account login, or asking about CloudNote Pro’s general encryption and compliance protections?

questions.question: Where do I find the overview?
questions.expected_answer: Do you mean the Events Overview, Real-time Overview, or Audience Overview?

questions.question: How do I track the event?
questions.expected_answer: Are you adding a custom app event, tracking a push-notification event, or sending a service-worker hit through the Measurement Protocol?

questions.question: Which CloudNote plan should I choose?
questions.expected_answer: How many workspace members and how much storage do you need, and are version history, API volume, or SSO important?

questions.question: In which AWS region is CloudNote Pro’s production object storage hosted?
questions.expected_answer: The documents do not specify the AWS region for CloudNote Pro production storage.

questions.question: What is the exact date and time that CloudNote Pro version 4.2.2 will be released?
questions.expected_answer: The transcript only says the patch is expected later that day; it gives no exact date or time.

questions.question: How many paying CloudNote Pro users are currently active?
questions.expected_answer: The documents do not state the current number of paying or active users.

questions.question: What uptime SLA does CloudNote Pro guarantee to Enterprise customers?
questions.expected_answer: The documents do not specify an Enterprise uptime SLA.

questions.question: Which named employee approved the HIPAA Business Associate Agreement?
questions.expected_answer: The documents say HIPAA Business Associate Agreements are available upon request but name no approver.

questions.question: What was CloudNote Pro’s audited revenue in fiscal year 2024?
questions.expected_answer: The documents do not state CloudNote Pro’s audited fiscal-year 2024 revenue.

questions.question: How many total seats are currently active on the account in support record 001?
questions.expected_answer: The transcript says two additional members accepted invitations but does not state the account’s total active seat count.
